gourjault-170-3.summary: The French plenipotentiaries at Cologne want to know whether Réveillon can hold Kaiserswerth with his French and Swiss troops, with Germans inside the place, in case the Elector of Cologne turns his coat and listens to the Emperor; the matter is to stay between Chamilly, Réveillon and Bréant.

gourjault-170-4.summary: The ambassadors assure Réveillon he will be informed of everything: the Elector of Cologne has promised to listen to no proposal from the Emperor until he has the King's answer to a letter he is sending by a gentleman of his chamber.

system: Numerical syllabic nomenclator, groups 6-319 separated by colons, laid out approximately alphabetically (a = 55 ... z = 316, with inversions) with whole words filed in place, a few homophones and three name codes
